_about: Shared by core/tests/unit/test_hourly_grid_parity.py and frontend/src/utils/hourlyGridParity.test.js. The request page (utils/rental.js: freeStartTimes, isHourlyPickupDisabled) and the server (Collection.reservation_hour_violation, has_overlap, _day_has_a_free_hour) each decide which hourly starts exist; each case's expectations are worked out by hand in its note, and both suites must agree with them. A Monday throughout (weekday key "0"). now_minutes is the clock on that same day, or null for a day that is not today. A case may carry units (how many identical ones the space has; absent = 1) and served_periods: what the server serves the browser as taken, which BookingPeriod.saturated_periods works out from bookings — null is a whole day, [start, end] an hourly stretch. Absent, it is the bookings themselves (one unit). The page is fed served_periods, the server is asked for starts with units. A case may also carry pause, [from, until] in days counted from that Monday (0 is the Monday itself), both included: the thing is paused then, which is served as one more whole-day stretch (null) in served_periods and which no start can overlap.

cases.name: two blocks, a two-hour slot, nothing booked
cases.note: Hourly grid from each block's opening: 10,11,12 fit 120 min before 14:00; 16,17,18 before 20:00.

cases.name: a block opening off the hour keeps its own grid
cases.note: The grid runs from 10:20, not from midnight: 10:20, 11:20, 12:20, 13:20 each leave an hour before 14:20.

cases.name: a 45-minute step, a 90-minute slot
a free hour that sits off the grid is no slot
cases.note: Booked 10:00-10:30 and 11:30-14:00 leave 10:30-11:30 free — sixty minutes, but no start at 10:30 exists on a grid from 10:00, and 11:00 would overlap 11:30.

cases.name: the same gap widened to fit the 11:00 start
cases.note: With the second booking starting at 12:00, 11:00-12:00 is free and on the grid; ending exactly as a booking starts is no clash.

cases.name: today, from the current minute on
cases.note: At 12:01, 12:00 has begun; 13:00 and the afternoon block remain. A start in the current minute would still count — 12:01 is simply not on the grid.

cases.name: today, at the very minute a slot starts
cases.note: At 13:00 exactly, 13:00 has not begun yet — the same rule on both sides.

cases.name: today, once the last start has passed
cases.note: One block 10:00-14:00 on the hour: its last start, 13:00, has begun by 13:30.

cases.name: a whole-day booking closes every hour
cases.note: A booking with no times (a loan, a day-unit reservation) takes the whole day.

cases.name: units 2: two bookings that overlap by half
cases.note: Booked 10-12 and 11-13: two at once only from 11:00 to 12:00, so that hour is full. 10:00 ends as the full hour begins and 12:00 begins as it ends — touching is no overlap.

cases.name: units 3: three in a staircase are never three at once
cases.note: Booked 10-12, 11-13 and 12-14: at most two at any moment, so with three units nothing is full and every hour starts.

cases.name: units 2: the same staircase fills the middle
cases.note: The staircase again, with two units: two are on from 11:00 to 12:00 and again from 12:00 to 13:00. The two stretches run into each other, so 11:00-13:00 is full.

cases.name: units 2: bookings that only touch are never together
cases.note: Booked 10-11 and 11-12: never two at once, nothing is full.

cases.name: units 2: a whole-day booking plus an hourly one
cases.note: The whole-day booking counts at every hour, so one more booked 11-12 makes two at once there: 11:00-12:00 is full.

cases.name: units 3: a whole-day booking plus two that overlap
cases.note: One whole-day booking leaves a threshold of two: the 10-12 and 11-13 bookings are both on from 11:00 to 12:00.

cases.name: units 2: two whole-day bookings fill the day
cases.note: Two whole-day bookings are two at once all day.

cases.name: units 4: three at once still leave room
cases.note: Three bookings 10-14 are three at once, one short of four units: nothing is full.

cases.name: units 2: a full band in the middle of the morning
cases.note: Booked 10:30-12:30 and 11:00-12:00: two at once only from 11:00 to 12:00. On the half-hour grid 10:00 (until 11:00) fits, 10:30, 11:00 and 11:30 run into the full hour, and 12:00, 12:30 and 13:00 are clear.

cases.name: units 2: two bookings across the whole block leave no slot
cases.note: Booked 10-14 twice: the whole block is full and no hour starts.

cases.name: a one-day pause takes the whole day
cases.note: Nothing is booked, but the thing is paused on this Monday: the day is served as one whole-day stretch and no hour starts.

cases.name: units 2: a pause on top of a full hour
cases.note: Booked 10-12 and 11-13 with two units (11:00-12:00 is full) and the thing paused on this Monday and the next day: the server serves both the full hour and the whole-day pause, and no hour starts.
